title: Starter Journey illustration kit for API/SDK quickstart (auth, keys, streaming, tool calls)
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: Produce a compact, production-ready illustration kit and annotated screenshots for the API/SDK quickstart docs. Scope covers four micro-flows: API key onboarding and rotation, streaming connections (client-side + server events), tool-calling flow (function schema + result cards), and a compact auth-first hero tile for README/landing. Deliverables: 12 SVG/PNG illustrations (light + dark variants), 6 annotated screenshot frames (1280x720), 3 micro-motion specs (Lottie JSON + short MP4 previews), and a Figma component page with export-ready assets and naming conventions. Accessibility: all illustrations must meet 4.5:1 contrast for text overlays and include short alt copy in the Figma notes. Constraints: keep artwork file size under 200KB per SVG after optimization; maintain alignment with brand color tokens (token names included below).

Visual approach: use simplified device frames, single-character developer avatars (diverse skin tones), and lightweight connector lines to show stream/KV flow. For tool-calling, visualize function schema as a collapsible card with call + response micro-animations. Aim for consistent corner radii, 8px grid, and tokenized shadows to match existing console UI.

Export rules and naming: exports/illustrations/starter-journey/{flow}/{name}--[light|dark]--v1.{svg|png}. Motion previews under exports/motion/{name}--preview.mp4. Add alt text in the Figma layer metadata and a short caption in each exported screenshot.

Primary links to reference artifacts and repo: Figma board (working): https://www.figma.com/file/RedwoodOnboard/starter-journey-ARTIFACTS, Confluence PRD: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/3089472/API+Quickstart+PRD, Docs repo draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4527, Design tokens: https://design-system.redwood.ai/tokens, Example runtime trace dashboard (for screenshot capture): https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/trace/quickstart

acceptance_criteria: All illustrations exported in both light and dark themes and uploaded to exports/illustrations/starter-journey/
Annotated screenshots captured from a realistic console session (not mocked) with stable API keys sandbox and included in docs PR
Motion specs include Lottie JSON and MP4 preview under exports/motion/ with captions
Figma file contains written alt text for each exported asset and adheres to naming convention
Design tokens used (primary/neutral/alert) and color contrast verified (4.5:1)
notes: Follow-up tasks after merge: 1) Handoff checklist to engineering for in-doc screenshot capture steps and environment variables; 2) Small-sample user test with two developer folks to validate clarity of tool-calling illustration; 3) Add localized copy keys for hero caption in i18n backlog.
